critical_policy.scope: All 14 universities in the current university master dataset.

critical_policy.course_rule: Only compare the same course/degree across both universities. Do not compare unlike programmes.
critical_policy.fee_rule: Use the current published fee only. If the university does not publish one, show 'Fee not published — manually researched from the official website' and link to the official source.
critical_policy.recognition_rule: Display recognition from the master dataset and regulator/university source. Never copy competitor approval lists.
critical_policy.placement_rule: Never turn placement assistance into guaranteed placement. Never invent recruiter counts, salaries or placement percentages.
critical_policy.curriculum_rule: Use university-specific curriculum when verified. Otherwise use the existing common-course curriculum layer and label it clearly as a common/reference curriculum.
critical_policy.freshness_rule: Every volatile fact should display last_verified and source.

url_strategy.redirects: 301 only when replacing a genuine old/duplicate URL.
url_strategy.section_navigation: Use hash anchors; do not create thin indexable URLs for fees/admission/exams/etc.

page_structure.table_rule: Use tables for facts; use prose/cards for interpretation.

desktop.comparison_table: Sticky first column; horizontal scroll only inside the table container.
desktop.toc: Sticky/compact section navigation on wide screens.
desktop.hero: University A vs University B + course selector + concise value proposition + CTA.
desktop.cta: Compare, download comparison, or request guidance; never obstruct primary content.

mobile.comparison_table: Never cause page-level horizontal overflow. Use stacked comparison cards for most rows and a contained horizontal-scroll table only for dense factual matrices.
mobile.quick_facts: 2-column cards that collapse to one column below 360px.
mobile.toc: Horizontal scroll chip navigation or collapsible 'On this page'.
mobile.faq: Accordion with one open item at a time; comfortable 44px+ touch target.
mobile.cta: Sticky bottom CTA only if it does not cover browser controls or content; keep dismissible.
